title: Geotechnical report shows rock layer at 0.8m in Block 6 (design assumed 1.5m)
description: Geotechnical investigation confirmatory boreholes in Block 6 encounter hard rock layer refusal at 0.8m depth, whereas tender engineering design assumed minimum refusal at 1.5m. Standard hydraulic ramming cannot achieve required embedment depth.
expected_chain_reaction: TERRA issues FDC for pre-drilling / concrete foundation redesign, COUNSEL files Sub-Clause 4.12 Unforeseeable Physical Conditions claim, KRONOS logs delay event DEL-001.

title: UzbekEnergo requests protection philosophy resubmission — new grid code issued
description: National Grid operator UzbekEnergo gazettes updated Grid Code requirements mandating revised fault-ride-through (FRT) curves and high-voltage ride-through (HVRT) criteria, rejecting Rev A Substation Protection Philosophy.
expected_chain_reaction: Design delay on GSS single-line and protection schematics, KRONOS logs EOT event DEL-002, COUNSEL issues Sub-Clause 20.1 notice.

title: Module vendor (LUMINOS) requests 8-week delivery extension due to cell shortage
description: Tier-1 PV Module manufacturer LUMINOS formally notifies Tier-1 wafer/cell supply disruption across Ningbo factories, requesting 8-week delivery postponement for initial 30MW shipment batches.
expected_chain_reaction: WATT flags near-critical path erosion, CONVOY negotiates split-shipment air/rail freight acceleration, KRONOS runs Time Impact Analysis (TIA), CLAIMS reserves vendor liquidated damages.

title: Dust storm shuts down module installation for 3 days
description: Severe Kyzylkum desert sandstorm sweeps project site with sustained winds exceeding 24 m/s and visibility under 20m. EHS mandates site-wide stop-work.
expected_chain_reaction: AEGIS issues safety stop-work order, EREKTOR claims standby labor costs, KRONOS logs weather delay event.

title: GROUNDWORK pile driving crew reduced from 4 rigs to 2 (equipment breakdown)
description: Hydraulic ramming rigs RG-03 and RG-04 suffer mast cylinder fractures due to calcified soil shocks. Subcontractor GROUNDWORK lacks local spare cylinders in Uzbekistan.
expected_chain_reaction: Daily piling output drops from 400 to 200 piles/day, SPI slips, RAMPART issues 7-day cure notice, LEDGER quantifies potential subcontractor back-charge.

title: NCR raised: 47 piles in Block 3 out of tolerance (E-W deviation >20mm)
description: QA/QC topographical as-built survey reveals 47 driven steel H-piles in Array Block 3 exceed maximum lateral tolerance (22mm to 38mm deviation vs 20mm spec), preventing tracker bearing bracket alignment.
expected_chain_reaction: SENTINEL issues Category B NCR, EREKTOR disputes survey bench-marks, PRISM conducts joint total-station survey, re-driving/slotting remedy ordered.

title: 33kV MV cable joint fails VLF test on Circuit INV3 to Main SS
description: During commissioning dry-run Very Low Frequency (VLF) withstand testing at 0.1Hz 3U0, MV cable straight joint J-037 on Circuit INV3 breaks down due to improper semi-con screen stripping.
expected_chain_reaction: Testing immediately halted, fault localized via TDR, joint cut out, ELECTRA re-makes joint with factory certified jointer, extended VLF test re-run.

title: Client (PATRON) rejects MPR — claims progress is overstated by 8%
description: Employer Owner's Engineer (OE) rejects Monthly Progress Report (MPR) No. 08 and IPC certification, alleging unverified piles and staging laydown materials were credited as installed.
expected_chain_reaction: SIGMA reconciles rule of credit, KRONOS re-submits earned value sheets, COUNSEL prepares formal FIDIC rebuttal, payment certificate dispute resolved.

title: 220kV transformer held at Khorgos border — missing GOST-UZ certificate
description: Multi-axle heavy transport carrying the 100MVA 220kV Main Power Transformer is impounded at Kazakhstan-Uzbekistan Khorgos border customs due to missing certified Uzbek GOST-UZ conformity stamp.
expected_chain_reaction: ROUTE mobilizes Tashkent customs broker for expedited fast-track technical clearance, COUNSEL files EOT notice for border regulatory delay, KRONOS models critical path delay.

title: Transformer arrives with 3-axis impact recorder showing 5.2g (threshold 4g)
description: Upon arrival at site laydown, inspection of the 220kV MPT impact recorder reveals longitudinal shock shockwave of 5.2g (exceeding maximum contract threshold of 4.0g) incurred during rail transshipment.
expected_chain_reaction: Equipment quarantined, OEM field engineers dispatched from manufacturer, Sweep Frequency Response Analysis (SFRA) and internal core inspection ordered, marine transit cargo insurance claim logged.

title: Subcontractor ELECTRA threatens to demobilise — claims EPC owes 3 months back-payment
description: Electrical installation subcontractor ELECTRA issues 14-day notice of intention to demobilize all 120 technicians from site, alleging non-certification of IPCs 07, 08, and 09.
expected_chain_reaction: CHECKER performs expedited billing audit, COUNSEL assesses contract terms, ATLAS conducts emergency commercial reconciliation with ELECTRA executives.

title: Extreme winter — ground frozen solid, piling and concrete impossible for 18 days
description: Siberian anti-cyclone causes temperatures to plunge to -26°C with ground frost penetrating 1.2m below surface. In-situ concrete batching and pile ramming are physically impossible.
expected_chain_reaction: Site freeze stop-work declared, KRONOS evaluates 10-year meteorological historical weather data to assess exceptional adverse climatic conditions under FIDIC Sub-Clause 8.4(c), CLAIMS files EOT notice.

title: PATRON issues scope change instruction — add 5MW BESS reserve area
description: Employer issues formal Variation Instruction under FIDIC Sub-Clause 13.1 requiring EPC Contractor to grade, fence, and install 33kV switchgear feeder bay provisions for future 5MW Battery Energy Storage System (BESS).
expected_chain_reaction: ARCHON initiates BESS interface civil/electrical design, COUNSEL submits Sub-Clause 13.3 Variation Proposal, KRONOS adds schedule fragnet, LEDGER prepares cost estimate.

title: Protection relay settings rejected by UzbekEnergo — new reactive power spec
description: UzbekEnergo dispatch centre rejects GSS feeder relay protection calculations, citing revised reactive power Q-capability and voltage stability limits under weak-grid contingencies.
expected_chain_reaction: CIPHER recalculates relay coordination and reactive compensation curves, numerical relays re-programmed, secondary injection tests repeated, utility delay logged.

title: IV curve test shows 12% of strings in Block 4 below Fill Factor threshold
description: Cold commissioning string testing in Array Block 4 indicates 12% of PV strings suffer degraded Fill Factor (FF < 72% vs 78% guarantee). Electroluminescence (EL) imaging confirms microcracks in 200 module units.
expected_chain_reaction: SENTINEL issues containment notice, EREKTOR conducts batch tracing, defective modules unmounted and quarantined, warranty claim served on LUMINOS.

title: UzbekEnergo delays energisation consent by 4 weeks — internal approval backlog
description: Grid company UzbekEnergo withholds Energisation Protocol sign-off due to administrative backlog in regional dispatch transmission line interlocking sign-offs, holding project energization in limbo.
expected_chain_reaction: COUNSEL issues Sub-Clause 8.4(e) notice for delays caused by authorities, KRONOS updates milestone forecast to COD, ATLAS escalates to Ministry of Energy.

title: Performance Ratio test result: 76% (target 80%) — below PAC threshold
description: Initial 7-day continuous Provisional Acceptance Certificate (PAC) Performance Ratio (PR) test records 76.2% against contractual guaranteed threshold of 80.0%, triggering Client withholding of PAC.
expected_chain_reaction: T&C investigates root causes: soiling losses, pyranometer sensor calibration, clipping, tracker tracking algorithm mismatch; corrective tuning and 7-day re-test conducted.
